blocks.text: The cast members of the upcoming satirical comedy “Red Crown” said the film aims to present a different picture of women in pageantry — one that emphasizes healthy competition, sisterhood and individuality rather than rivalry and stereotypes. The film, directed by Dominic Zapata and written by Kit Villanueva and Ken de Leon, explores the competitive world of beauty pageants through a fictional “Queen of the Islands” competition.
